messages:
sophia: Heads-up — planning a runtime kernel swap on staging: v4.2.0 -> v4.3.0 to validate the q8 quant builds. aiming for a 22:30 UTC change window, will pin staging and run a 5% canary. @ajay @marco FYI.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging/runtime-kernel v4.3.0. Suggested command: `/deploy staging runtime-kernel v4.3.0 --canary=5% --pin-ttl=30m`

ajay: Ack. Rollback criteria I care about: 1) >3% relative increase in error rate for production-like traffic on p95; 2) decode mismatch >0.5% on our eval set; 3) sustained memory growth >15% on any tail node. Prefer auto-rollback on #1.

marco: I'll take release notes and the compat matrix. Add: matmul alignment fix and q8 packing perf notes. Also confirm paged KV cache interaction before ramp.

eric (oncall): Heads up — infra has a nightly window 23:15-23:45 UTC with network migrations. Can we avoid overlap? either shift earlier to 22:30 or enforce `--no-drain`.

sophia: OK shifting to 22:30 UTC to avoid infra. changing pin-ttl to 45m.

deploy-bot: schedule updated: 1719442200 (22:30 UTC). New command:
```
/deploy staging runtime-kernel v4.3.0 --canary=5% --pin-ttl=45m --no-drain
```

ajay: Preflight checklist:
- build sha: abcdef123
- quant artifact: q8-v1.tar.gz
- smoke: `make smoke-runtime` (passes locally)
- perf baseline: linked
If anything flakes tag @ajay and I'll cut rollback.

marco: Release-notes draft lines:
- runtime kernel v4.3.0: matmul alignment fixes reduce tail latency
- q8 packing: ~12% throughput improvement on T4
- known: small decode variance for very long prompts — monitoring
I'll post to #eng-releases at go/no-go.

sophia: Go/no-go at +10m after the deploy starts. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime-canary?c=1719442200

deploy-bot: running preflight checks...
- artifacts available: yes
- compat matrix: ok
- canary targets: 5% across staging pools
preflight: PASS

eric (oncall): If producer queue retry rate >2x, immediate pin + rollback. Post logs to #incidents and ping me.

ajay: Rollback quick command for convenience:
```
/deploy rollback staging runtime-kernel --to=4.2.0 --reason="canary-signal"
```

sophia: Starting window in 30s and invoking deploybot.

deploy-bot: executing: `/deploy staging runtime-kernel v4.3.0 --canary=5% --pin-ttl=45m --no-drain`
canary started: 5% traffic -> v4.3.0
smoke: PASS
initial latency p95 delta: +0.8% (within threshold)
monitoring live metrics...

marco: seeing a small bump on very long prompts but within expected. publishing release-notes to #eng-releases now.

ajay: telemetry update: decode variance 0.42% on eval set (below 0.5% threshold). memory stable.

eric (oncall): queues normal, no retry spike. standing by.

sophia: Marking go if numbers stay. plan to ramp to 25% in 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp: 5% -> 25% in 15m.

marco: note to include rollback snippet and mitigation steps in release-notes.

ajay: perf trace: https://perf.internal/traces/xyz123

deploy-bot: ramp complete -> 25% at 1719442520. p95 delta now +1.3% (still within SLO guardrails).

sophia: Thanks all — closing the change window. keeping the pin until the 45m TTL expires. Will open a short follow-up if anything drifts.
